models_evaluated: end-to-end LLM baselines (open-source and proprietary, unnamed)

links.outcome: Robustness of end-to-end LLM diagnostic performance to sentence-order permutation of narratives
links.effect: End-to-end LLMs showed unstable sensitivity-specificity trade-offs and greater degradation under narrative reordering than the hybrid ClaMPAPP system.
links.quote: End-to-end LLMs showed unstable sensitivity-specificity trade-offs and greater degradation under narrative reordering.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM only as a schema-constrained feature-extraction interface feeding a structured ML classifier rather than as the final decision-maker
Deterministic plausibility checks on LLM-extracted features before passing them to a downstream predictive model

screen.reason: Evaluates a deployment architecture safeguard (hybrid pipeline using schema-constrained extraction and deterministic plausibility checks before risk scoring vs. end-to-end LLM) on clinical cohorts and tests robustness against narrative reordering.

primary.practice: hybrid LLM-feature-extractor with deterministic plausibility checks vs end-to-end LLM
